comments.text: The Leopard's return to the 2026 World Cup brought joy after 52 years, but the US currently advises against travel because of an Ebola outbreak and instability in the east.

comments.author: @UnseenOutlands
comments.text: The Congo River is fascinating, especially knowing how deep and powerful parts of it are. But I'm curious about the people living along its banks. Does the river make transportation and trade easier for remote villages, or do dangerous currents and seasonal changes create serious challenges?
